# Frozen test inputs

The four former example inputs here are test-only snapshots (#1402), not
gallery designs. Keep only files used by tests, probe sites and their local
resource closures. Their manifests retain only tested slides; Scene/SVG files
are fixed characterization inputs, not public derived-sync outputs.

Change them only with the corresponding test contract. Public example
consolidation must not change these inputs. The icon fixture is reproduced by
`python tools/generate_controller_z_icon_catalog.py`.
